note: Timed workload of each ported boundary for tools/benchmark_ports.py (tracker items P7 and P6). `case` is an index into evaluation/parity/<corpus>/cases.json; `iterations` is the program's repeat count for one slice, chosen so that one slice takes between about 0.05 s and 0.3 s on the Claude Code cloud VM. A repetition consists of `rounds` slices of every configuration, interleaved (see the tool). The first P7 run used one slice of about one second per repetition and was too noisy on this machine (evaluation/results/tracker/P7/README.md).

nginx_openssl.work: one TLS 1.3 connection, 1,500 rounds of a 512-byte request and a 4,096-byte response
